_doc: Curated gene lists for the Green Listed symbol box. Built by tools/build_gene_sets.py; do not edit by hand. Every symbol is resolved against the built-in human libraries (directly or through the human synonym table), so each list holds only genes at least one library can target. These are starting points to edit, not definitive gene families.

sets.label: Cancer genes
sets.description: Genes with an established role in cancer.

sets.label: Kinases
sets.description: The protein kinome — serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinases.

sets.label: Phosphatases
sets.description: Protein phosphatases, the counterparts to the kinases.

sets.label: Transcription factors
sets.source: Lambert et al. 2018, The Human Transcription Factors

sets.label: DNA damage response & repair
sets.description: Repair enzymes plus the checkpoint and signalling layer — includes TP53, MDM2, CHEK2 and ATM.

sets.label: Cell surface
sets.description: Proteins at the cell surface — the fraction reachable by antibodies and CAR targets.

sets.label: Druggable genome
sets.description: Genes whose products are considered tractable to small molecules or biologics.
